classification.habitat: Dry open ground, field margins and wasteland
classification.distribution: Common in many parts of India and other tropical Asian regions

identification.description: A spiny Solanum with prickles on stem and leaves, bluish-purple flowers and yellow globose berries marked by persistent calyx.
identification.stem: Green to grey-green stem armed with prickles.
identification.leaf: Alternate, lobed leaves with prickles on veins or petiole in many specimens.
identification.flower: Bluish or violet flowers with yellow stamens, typical of Solanum.
identification.fruit: Globose berry, green when immature and yellow when mature, often with persistent calyx.
identification.seed: Numerous small flattened seeds within berry.
identification.bark: Mature basal stem may become woody; bark is not the primary crude drug character.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Kantakari has a long traditional respiratory-system use and has been investigated experimentally. Modern findings should not be presented as established treatment for asthma or other disease.
modern_information.safety_notes: Use authenticated material and authoritative dosing/formulation references.
